result.summary:
Independently re-verified REQ-382 end to end; all 6 acceptance criteria confirmed against real source/tests, both independent test runs show zero REQ-382-attributable failures.

Pre-flight: confirmed via `tasklist //FI "IMAGENAME eq erl.exe"` that no erl.exe processes were running before starting (prior orphans, mentioned in the dispatch, already clear).

TEST RUN 1 -- independent `scripts/test_parallel.sh` (N=16, source: nproc), run synchronously in foreground, polled to completion (no cross-turn background wait). Combined: 4693 tests, 6 properties, 3 failures (4696/4699 passed) -- same combined COUNT as Step 4's report but a DIFFERENT failure SET, exactly as expected (per core-directives.md, never count-matched as evidence). Structural attribution via `git diff --name-only main...HEAD` (this branch touches: lib/letflow/{api/authorization,identity,identity/color_contrast,identity/tenant,identity/tenant_settings,plugs/api_pipeline,routers/tenant_settings}.ex, lib/letflow/design/req382-*.md, 7 test files, 10 handoff JSONs -- confirmed by direct `git diff --name-only main...HEAD` in this session):
  - partition 12 (2 failures): test/letflow/identity_test.exs REQ-019 AC1 resolve_tenant_by_realm/1 + resolve_realm_by_tenant/1 -- the documented ISS-0766 bpm-default tenant-row race (docs/issues/ISS-0766.yaml, read in full: known, open, MINOR, `related_requirements: [REQ-019]`, affected_files test/letflow/identity_test.exs + test/support/bpm_default_realm_displacement.ex). Neither file is in this branch's diff. Pre-existing, diff-absent -- structurally cleared.
  - partition 9 (1 failure): test/letflow/ordering_test.exs AC15 -- a `clone_tenant_schema!/1` unique-constraint race in test/support/tenant_fixture.ex / test/support/tenant_template.ex (same tenant-fixture-provisioning-race class as ISS-0766, and the class test/support/tenant_template_retry_test.exs already exists to harden against). Neither ordering_test.exs nor the tenant-fixture support files are in this branch's diff. Pre-existing/environmental, diff-absent -- structurally cleared. Not the same failure Step 4 saw (letflow.audit_issue_closures_test.exs) -- consistent with the dispatch's own expectation that a re-run need not reproduce the same set.

TEST RUN 2 -- independent `MIX_ENV=dev mix compile --warnings-as-errors --force`: exit 0, clean, zero warnings (AC6's compile half).

TEST RUN 3 -- independent `MIX_ENV=test mix letflow.check.test` (the stricter fresh-subprocess ISS-0069 gate), run synchronously, polled to completion, full output captured to a file (not just `tail`). Result: FAILED (scripts/test_parallel.sh exited 1 inside the task) with combined 4695/4699 passed, 4 failures: partition 12 = the same 2 ISS-0766 identity_test.exs failures as above (pre-existing, diff-absent); partition 8 = 2 DIFFERENT failures never seen in TEST RUN 1: test/letflow/engine/lua/sandbox_test.exs's static-grep AC1 test ("Lua.new( appears exactly once under lib/") and test/letflow/api/context_test.exs's `function_exported?(Context, :scoped_repo_opts, 1)` arity check. Neither test/support file nor lib/letflow/engine/lua/sandbox.ex nor lib/letflow/api/context.ex is in this branch's diff. Re-ran this specific pair in isolation immediately after (`mix test test/letflow/engine/lua/sandbox_test.exs test/letflow/api/context_test.exs`): 58/58 passed clean -- and independently confirmed against current on-disk source that `grep -rn "Lua.new(" lib --include=*.ex` returns exactly one hit (lib/letflow/engine/lua/sandbox.ex:274) and `Letflow.Api.Context.scoped_repo_opts/1` is genuinely defined (lib/letflow/api/context.ex:219). Both assertions are true against real current source; the partition-8 failures were therefore transient artifacts of this SHARED, non-worktree checkout's concurrent activity (other agents actively running in c:\Users\tvolo\dev\ai-dala\letflow today, per this run's own dispatch note) -- most plausibly a `_build/test` compile-manifest race during `scripts/test_parallel.sh`'s sequential per-partition build-path seeding step, not a real regression. The ISS-0069 target substring ("default values for the optional arguments") was searched for and is ABSENT from both full check.test run logs -- the actual class this gate exists to catch did not recur.

None of the 5 distinct failure signatures seen across TEST RUN 1 and TEST RUN 3 today (2x ISS-0766, ordering_test.exs clone race, sandbox_test.exs grep, context_test.exs arity) touch any file in this branch's diff, and none are the ISS-0069 dead-default-argument class. REQ-382's own new tests (test/letflow/routers/tenant_settings_test.exs, test/letflow/identity/color_contrast_test.exs) passed clean in every run today, including inside the full-suite runs.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA -- each confirmed directly against current source/tests, not against prior step summaries:
  - AC1 (real HTTP round-trip, not a direct Letflow.Identity.update_tenant_settings/2 call): confirmed. lib/letflow/routers/tenant_settings.ex uses `use Letflow.Api.AuthorizedRouter` (real match->Authorize->dispatch plug pipeline). test/letflow/routers/tenant_settings_test.exs's AC1 test dispatches PATCH through `Letflow.Routers.TenantSettings.call/2` (exercising the real AuthorizedRouter plug chain, matching this codebase's own established convention in tenants_test.exs/req196_audit_route_test.exs, per the test file's own moduledoc) and then dispatches a real `GET /api/tenant-config` through the full, unmodified `Letflow.Router` to prove the value round-trips through the actual read endpoint. A separate authorization-describe test in the same file additionally dispatches a PATCH through the full `Letflow.Router` mount (401 case), confirming the router is genuinely reachable end-to-end, not just unit-tested in isolation. Satisfied.
  - AC2 (WCAG 4.5:1 contrast refusal, plain-language message, previous colour unchanged): confirmed. lib/letflow/identity/color_contrast.ex implements the real WCAG 2.1 relative-luminance/contrast-ratio formula (verified: sRGB channel linearization, BT.709 coefficients 0.2126/0.7152/0.0722, symmetric (L_lighter+0.05)/(L_darker+0.05), 4.5 threshold constant). lib/letflow/identity/tenant.ex's `validate_brand_colors/2` calls it against both tokens.css reference backgrounds (#F8F9FA page, #FFFFFF card) and builds a plain-language message naming the threshold and both computed ratios (`brand_colors_contrast_error/2`). The whole `:settings` changeset is rejected on failure (cast list unaffected, nothing partially applied). test_settings_test.exs AC2 test asserts 422, message contains "4.5" and "contrast"/"WCAG", and re-reads the row to assert the previously-stored colour is unchanged. Satisfied.
  - AC3 (partial application of out-of-allowlist keys, never a full-request failure or 500): confirmed. Router's `partition_top_level/1` and `partition_brand_colors/1` split recognized/rejected keys before merging only the recognized part; three dedicated AC3 tests cover an out-of-allowlist top-level key, an out-of-allowlist brand_colors sub-key, and a request consisting only of bad keys (200, unchanged settings, never 500). Satisfied.
  - AC4 (exactly one Audit entry naming tenant/actor/rejected keys+values, surfaced via GET /api/v1/audit with no frontend change): confirmed. `maybe_record_rejected_keys/5` writes one `Letflow.Audit` entry with actor_id/resource_type/resource_id/rejected top-level+brand_colors keys+attempted values; a no-op guard clause (`maybe_record_rejected_keys(_,_,_,[],[])`) skips the write when everything is recognized. Three AC4 tests assert: content of a single entry (dispatched through `Letflow.Routers.Audit.call/2`, the same route AuditLogPage.tsx queries), zero entries when everything is recognized, and zero entries on a WCAG value-rejection (audit is scoped to key-rejection only, not value-validation, matching the design doc). Satisfied.
  - AC5 (settings_changeset/2 cast list stays [:settings] only, endpoint cannot touch status/slug/idp_realm_id/display_name): confirmed by direct read of lib/letflow/identity/tenant.ex:190-194 -- `cast(tenant, attrs, [:settings])`, unchanged from before this requirement, only a `validate_change` added. test_settings_test.exs's AC5 test submits all four protected fields plus one recognized key in one request and asserts all four are unchanged post-request while the recognized key applied. Satisfied.
  - AC6 (mix compile --warnings-as-errors and mix test both pass, real output quoted; SECURITY-REVIEWER sign-off required): compile confirmed clean (exit 0, this session, see TEST RUN 2 above). mix test: both independent full-suite runs (test_parallel.sh and letflow.check.test) show zero REQ-382-attributable failures, per the structural attribution above -- REQ-382's own new tests pass in every run. SECURITY-REVIEWER sign-off: handoffs/WF02-REQ382-20260922/step-02c-security-reviewer-regate.json read in full -- genuine PASS, not a rubber stamp: it verifies the specific prior BLOCKER fix (Letflow.Routers.TenantSettings registration in authorization_enforcement_test.exs's @routers/@mount_prefix) by direct file read, confirms via a drift-detection loop (revert-rerun-restore, 17 vs 16 passed) that the router is genuinely exercised by the test loop rather than inertly listed, and scope-verifies via `git diff f19afae9 b9a681c1 --stat` that the rework touched only the 3 expected files. Satisfied.

STALENESS CHECK: docs/requirements.yaml's REQ-382 entry still shows `status: pending` (confirmed by direct read, line 28304) -- correct and expected at this point in the workflow; DOC-UPDATER (Step 6) has not run yet. Not a finding.

Verdict: PASS. No requirement- or branch-attributable defect found in any acceptance criterion, compile, or either independent test run.
